name: Humboldt and Bonpland’s geography of plants
description: The 1807 plant geography book and associated schematic related vegetation distribution to environmental conditions and altitude.

date.basis: Year is the date of the described episode in the cited source, not necessarily the invention or first conception.

events.statement: Humboldt and Bonpland’s German plant geography book appeared in 1807.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest episode established from the sources collected for this scoped record, not a claim of global priority.

caveats: The 1807 Tableau is schematic: later examination found substantial inconsistencies with field records. The role of Andean scholars and their prior practices requires separate research; the date is this German edition, not proof of first such work. Moret and colleagues’ reassessment has drawn published scholarly responses; its interpretation should not be treated as uncontested.
